lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Time passed. Noah planted a vineyard. He worked the soil. He waited for the harvest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then he drank the wine. He drank too much. And he lay uncovered in his tent.

lines.speaker: son
lines.text: (Ham went out and told his brothers, mocking what he had seen.)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and walked in backwards, covering their father without looking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The one righteous man, who built the ark and survived the flood, stumbled here.

choices.label: You are Shem or Japheth — cover without looking 🙈
choices.note: "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem." — Gen 9:26. Dignity over exposure.

choices.label: You are Ham — go and tell 👁️
choices.note: "Cursed be Canaan." — Gen 9:25. The long shadow of a moment's disrespect.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The story doesn't end with the rainbow. It ends with a man who built everything right — and then failed in a tent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And it ends with two sons who chose, quietly, to show him grace anyway.
